title: Gevini ben Charson
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: Kohelet Rabbah 4:8 describes him as his mother's only son, blind in one eye, whose father left him great wealth. Resh Lakish reports that Belshazzar was born on the day Gevini ben Charson died. Hyman cites Matnot Kehunah for the explanation that Belshazzar took all Gevini's wealth.

notes.text: פ״ד-ח means 4:8, not 84:8. Matnot Kehunah is the commentary title, not “priestly gifts.” The consulted paragraph calls Belshazzar a Babylonian official; no identification with the Biblical king is imposed.
